scorecard.name: Empathy & Acknowledgment Statement
scorecard.coaching: Failed to handle or validate customer distress at turn 35 ([10:18]), where Henry expressed panic regarding guest complaints and negative reviews. The agent responded with sarcasm and hostility rather than an empathy or acknowledgment statement.

scorecard.name: Build rapport and observed professionalism
scorecard.coaching: Agent breached professionalism and rapport at turn 36 ([10:45]) by snapping rudely and sarcastically at the customer: 'Look Henry, it's a basic residential home router, not an enterprise commercial Cisco switch. If you are running a commercial hotel business out of your basement, you need to buy commercial networking gear instead of complaining to me.'

grader.scenario: Wi-Fi password reset and guest network isolation for home Airbnb suite
grader.notes: Technical configuration call by Tom setting up an isolated Guest Wi-Fi network and changing primary Wi-Fi credentials for an Airbnb host. The agent successfully configures subnet isolation and confirms private device security during an announced 45s hold. However, Tom fails Build Rapport and Empathy by snapping sarcastically at Henry when asked about printer routing, telling the customer to 'buy commercial gear instead of complaining to me' and ignoring his distress.

items.name: Hold time and Dead Air
items.evidence: 45s guest network provisioning hold was announced ('bear with me while I place you on a brief hold') and thanked upon return ('Thank you for your patience while holding').
